about: Adversarial documents (#1067): wrong readings that reached live fees and were taken down (limit_as_fee, wrong_amount, not_a_fee, eval_critical), each with the stored source lines around Knox's excerpt (agent_source_texts, cited by source_document_id, agent_source_text_id and text_hash; up to 4 lines before and 2 after). Replayed in CI by src/lib/agents/deming/adversarial-documents.test.ts with no database and no model calls. refused_by names every pure check that refused the wrong reading when the fixture was read: knox (the free readers no longer read that amount under that category), darwin (passesDarwinChecks), source_check (checkFeeAgainstSource's reason), limit_guard (limitGuardVerdict's code) and eval_rule (ruleFor's rule). Each must keep refusing. known_misses are takedowns no pure check refuses yet; they run as expected failures. The injected sentence in the test is synthetic and labelled as such; it is not a bank's text.
